title: PaxDex / WARtool wild encounter safety rules
notes: Rules are evaluated against the four level-up moves available at each encounter level.
Safari contexts suppress battle-move, ability and held-item warnings.
Weather-dependent Dry Skin and Solar Power warnings are intentionally disabled until encounter weather is available.
Healing Wish, Lunar Dance, forced-switch moves and Drifblim compound interactions remain excluded pending in-game verification.

rules.effect: The wild Pokémon faints immediately after using this move.
rules.preparation: Bring a Pokémon with Damp and avoid removing or suppressing Damp before capture.

rules.effect: The wild Pokémon faints immediately after using Memento.
rules.preparation: Use Taunt, Imprison + Memento or another real move-denial method; trapping alone does not stop it.

rules.effect: The wild Pokémon faints after using Final Gambit.
rules.preparation: A Ghost-type target is immune; otherwise deny the move or capture quickly.

rules.effect: In a non-horde encounter, the wild Pokémon can faint when the perish count reaches zero.
rules.preparation: Use Soundproof, Imprison + Perish Song or finish the capture before the countdown ends.

rules.effect: The wild Pokémon can end the battle by using Teleport.
rules.preparation: Use Arena Trap, Imprison + Teleport or apply a trapping move immediately.

rules.effect: The wild Pokémon takes recoil damage after the attack connects.
rules.preparation: Avoid leaving it at 1 HP unless the recoil move is disabled or cannot damage your catcher.

rules.effect: The wild Pokémon takes very heavy recoil after Head Smash connects.
rules.preparation: Use a Rock-resistant, physically defensive target and deny the move or capture quickly; Ghost typing does not grant immunity.

rules.effect: The wild Pokémon takes crash damage if the move misses or fails.
rules.preparation: Do not use a Ghost-type or Protect-style failure setup while the wild Pokémon is at low HP unless the move is disabled.

rules.effect: A Ghost-type user sacrifices half of its maximum HP.
rules.preparation: Deny Curse or avoid reducing the wild Pokémon to a range where half-HP loss can faint it.

rules.effect: Belly Drum removes half of the user's current HP.
rules.preparation: Avoid False Swipe to 1 HP until Belly Drum is disabled, sealed or no longer usable.

rules.effect: The wild Pokémon becomes confused after its locked attack ends and may hurt itself.
rules.preparation: Use Own Tempo, Safeguard, move denial or capture before confusion becomes dangerous.

rules.effect: Rage Powder can redirect your move away from the intended horde or double-battle target.
rules.preparation: Use faster Extreme Speed or Feint, Taunt or Imprison. Grass types and Overcoat ignore Rage Powder, but Worry Seed can remove Overcoat.

rules.effect: Follow Me can redirect your move away from the intended horde or double-battle target.
rules.preparation: Use faster Extreme Speed or Feint, Taunt or Imprison. Grass typing and Overcoat do not ignore Follow Me.

rules.effect: The wild Pokémon may hold a Sticky Barb and lose HP at the end of each turn.
rules.preparation: Do not leave it at 1 HP. Remove or neutralize the item safely, use Heal Pulse, or capture quickly.

rules.effect: If Sketch fails, wild Smeargle can run out of usable PP and reach Struggle very quickly.
rules.preparation: Give it a safe move to copy immediately or use a capture plan that does not let Sketch repeatedly fail.

rules.effect: After Transform, copied moves have limited PP and can create an eventual Struggle risk.
rules.preparation: Lead with a safe, high-PP moveset that cannot self-KO, escape or make capture unnecessarily difficult.

rules.effect: The wild Pokémon can exchange held items with your active Pokémon.
rules.preparation: Do not bring a damaging item such as Toxic Orb on the active catcher unless Trick or Switcheroo is denied.

compoundRules.effect: This moveset can combine redirection with self-KO pressure, delayed turns or removal of Overcoat.
compoundRules.preparation: Do not rely on Overcoat alone. Plan priority control or Imprison/Taunt and remove non-targets without allowing redirection to protect them.
compoundRules.name: Rage Powder compound risk
